limitations: Local large-onsite-detuning asymptotics at equal pairing and tunnelling with nonzero unequal lead loss; no finite-detuning global classification, interactions or conductance results.
scientific_integrity: Analytic proof from an exact characteristic polynomial, a quantified real-root fold and an eigenvector-rank argument; supplementary symbolic and finite-parameter verification. Earlier Hamiltonian and qualitative spectral pinning are credited.
title: An inverse-square exceptional-point corridor in a far-detuned minimal Kitaev chain
